title: God Will Make a Way to Stand
story:
A young girl was learning to ride her bicycle without training wheels.

At first, she was excited, but when she started riding on her own, she became afraid of falling.

One afternoon, she reached a narrow part of the road and saw a small obstacle in front of her.

She wanted to give up and get off the bicycle.

Her father, who was riding beside her, encouraged her to slow down, look carefully, and keep going.

He showed her a safe way around the obstacle and stayed beside her until she passed it.

The obstacle did not disappear, but she was given a way to get through it safely.

In our lives, we also face temptations and difficult situations.

Sometimes temptation can feel too strong, and we may think that there is no way to resist it.

But God knows our struggles and does not leave us alone when we are tempted.

He gives us strength to stand and provides a way to escape from temptation.

We may need to walk away, say no, seek help, pray, or remove ourselves from a situation that could lead us into sin.

God's faithfulness gives us hope when we feel weak.

The next time you face temptation, remember that you are not powerless.

God is with you, and He can give you the strength and wisdom to choose what is right.
life_lesson: Temptation may feel strong, but you are never without a choice. Trust God's faithfulness, look for the way He provides, and choose to walk away from sin.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for being faithful and for staying with me when I face temptation.

When I feel weak, give me strength to choose what is right.

Help me recognize the way of escape that You provide and give me courage to take it.

Help me walk away from situations, thoughts, and choices that can lead me into sin.

Give me wisdom to know what pleases You and self-control to follow Your ways.

When I fail, help me turn back to You and receive Your forgiveness and strength.

Thank You because I can trust You in every difficult situation.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
What temptation do you find difficult to resist?

What practical step can you take when you face that temptation?

Are you looking to God for the strength and way of escape He provides?
verse: No temptation has overtaken you except what is common to mankind. And God is faithful; He will not let you be tempted beyond what you can bear. But when you are tempted, He will also provide a way out so that you can endure it.
